# MagicCore ability catalog

**Generated by `python tools/magic_docs.py` from the code's `///` summaries — do not edit.**
Read this instead of the engine source to know what exists. Each line: the piece, what it is,
and (in brackets) how many FRA cards use it, with a few. Find one: `grep -rn "record Name" MagicCore`.

## Effects — what a card does (`Effects/*.cs`)

- **`AddChargeCounters(Ref What, int N)`** — Gardenize: "put a charge counter on this enchantment". [1: Gardenize]
- **`AddCounters(Ref What, Count Amount)`** — "Put N +1/+1 counters on [What]" — creatures only, through MagicState.AddPlusOneCounters (Yoshimaru's replacement applies). Negative… [36: Chandra's Emberling, Yoshimaru, Scrappy Stray, Tam's Resistance…]
- **`AddLoyalty(Ref What, Count Amount)`** — "Put N loyalty counters on …" — no-op on anything that is not a planeswalker. [3: Way of the Mentor, Way of the Necromancer, Ajani Resolute]
- **`AddMana(ManaColor Color, Count Amount)`** — "Add {C}" — or Gardenize's "{G} for each charge counter", counted as it resolves. [6: Koth, the Geomancer, Way of the Pyromancer, Konstrari Charm…]

## Conditions — "if …" (`Effects/Conditions.cs`)

- **`Always`** — A "you may" that can always be done. [2: Clash of Elements, Plan for All Outcomes]
- **`AtLeast(Count Count, int N)`** — Eye of Jace: "if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard". [19: Eye of Jace, Edgar, Moonlit Sovereign, Guiding Hydra…]
- **`CanPay(ManaCost Cost)`** — Proft: "you may pay {2}" — asked only when it can be paid. [2: Proft, Consulting Detective, Lich's Relic]
- **`CastFrom(ZoneType Zone)`** — "If this spell was cast from a graveyard" / "wasn't cast from your hand" (with Not). [2: Recursive Recruitment, Twinned Vision]
- **`DuringYourTurn`** — Rescue Girl's "activate only during your turn"; Skilled Battlecarver's "during your turn" static. [2: Skilled Battlecarver, Rescue Girl, First Responder]
- **`GraveyardHasCopiesOfSource(int N)`** — "[N] cards named [this card] in your graveyard" — not this one. [1: Sphinx's Approach]
- **`Matches(Ref What, Filters.Filter Filter)`** — "If [something] is [filter]" — any object the Ref names matches. Prophesied End: "if it wasn't attacking" is Matches(Ref.Target(0),… [6: Prophesied End, Koth, the Geomancer, Budding Insurgent…]
- **`Not(Condition Inner)`** — The opposite of a condition — "isn't", "wasn't", "unless". [6: Edgar, Moonlit Sovereign, Twinned Vision, Ruric Thar, Magecrusher…]
- **`SourceWasCast`** — Null Summoner: "if you cast it" — it entered by resolving as a spell. Read from the source as it was when it triggered, so it leaving in… [2: Null Summoner, Uldaros Theorix]
- **`YouCanBehold(string Subtype)`** — "You can behold a [Subtype]" — Theorist's Sanctum: a Jace you control or in your hand (it costs nothing). [1: Theorist's Sanctum]
- **`YourLibraryIsEmpty`** — Fblthp: "If your library has no cards in it". [1: Fblthp, Impossibly Lost]

## Filters — which objects; scripts write them through `Is` (`Filters/`)

- **`AllOf(Filter A, Filter B)`** — "Nontoken creature": both.
- **`AnyOf(Filter A, Filter B)`** — "Creature or planeswalker": either.
- **`HasKeyword(string Keyword)`** — Konstrari Charm: "creature with flying" — through s.Has, so a granted keyword counts.
- **`HasProperty(Property Property)`** — Gallia: "each other creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it" — a yes/no property of one object.
- **`NotFilter(Filter Inner)`** — "Noncreature", "another": not.
- **`OfColor(ManaColor Color)`** — Terminal Criticism: "that's blue or red" — one colour each, joined with |.
- **`OfController(Whose Whose)`** — Mabel: "creature you control"; Gideon the Oathless: "an opponent controls" — or the player itself.
- **`OfSubtype(string Subtype)`** — Koth: "a Plains"; Saheeli: "Thopters".
- **`OfSupertype(Supertype Supertypes)`** — Fateshaper Aspirant: "target legendary card" — any of these supertypes.
- **`OfType(CardType Types)`** — Vraska: "artifact creatures"; "artifact or enchantment" — a card of ANY of these types.
- **`StatBetween(Stat Stat, int Min, int Max)`** — Tetsuko: "power or toughness 1 or less"; Your Fate Ends Here: "mana value 3 or greater". Real P/T, through s.Power / s.Toughness — a…

## Components — abilities, statics, replacements, markers on a card

- **`ActivatedAbilityComponent(ManaCost Cost, ImmutableList<GameAction> Effects)`** — "[Cost]: [effects]." Uses the stack. Mana abilities are ManaAbilityComponent, which does not. [56: Yoshimaru, Scrappy Stray, Budding Insurgent, Living Library…]
  - `SacrificeSelf` (bool): "Sacrifice this [permanent]:" — part of the cost.
  - `Sacrifice` (Filters.Filter?): "Sacrifice another creature or planeswalker:" — which of yours may be sacrificed as the cost. Null: no such…
  - `SorcerySpeed` (bool): "Activate only as a sorcery."
  - `From` (ZoneType): Where it is activated from: the battlefield, or a card in your hand (cycling) or graveyard.
  - `ExileSelf` (bool): "Exile this card from your graveyard:" — part of the cost.
  - `DiscardSelf` (bool): Cycling: "Discard this card:" — part of the cost.
  - `DiscardACard` (bool): Hallway Heckler: "Discard a card:" — the card is chosen like a sacrifice.
  - `TapUntapped` (int): Tenured Tethermage: "Tap two untapped artifacts you control:" — how many, of what type.
  - `DiscardMustBe` (Cards.Supertype): Solitary Cell: "Discard a legendary card:" — what the discarded card must be.
  - `ExileFromGraveyard` (Filters.Filter?): Gallia, Tragic Host: "Exile another creature card from your graveyard:" — what may be exiled. Which cards in…
  - `CostsLessPerCounterOnTarget` (bool): Warrior's Blades' equip: "{1} less for each +1/+1 counter on the creature it targets".
  - `OnlyIf` (Condition?): "Activate only if [condition]" — judged as it is activated.
  - `Exhaust` (bool): "Exhaust — … (Activate each exhaust ability only once.)" — stamped on the card as it is activated. ponytail:…
- **`AmountReplacement(ReplaceableEvent Event, int Bonus)`** — "… that much plus Bonus instead" — on a permanent; Rules.Replacements reads it where the event happens. [2: Tomik, Izzet Sparkmage, Yoshimaru, Beloved Companion]

- **`MayCastWhatItExiled(Condition While)`** — Null Summoner: "As long as [While], you may cast the exiled card, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell." On the source — a… [1: Null Summoner]
- **`NoSpellsOrAbilitiesDuringCombat`** — Yuriko: "During combat, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities." [1: Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty]

  - `CantBeCountered` (bool): Theorist's Proxy: this cast can't be countered — gone with the stack object, so a recast can be.

- **`PrepareSpellComponent(Cards.CardFace Face, SpellEffectsComponent Text)`** — A prepare card's spell half (CR: "a preparation card is a creature card in every zone"): its face and its text.
- **`PreparedCopyOf(int CreatureId, int Incarnation)`** — On a prepared copy in exile: the creature (and which object of it) it belongs to.
- **`SacrificeOrPayAdditionalCost(Filters.Filter Sacrifice, int Generic)`** — Silence the Echo: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a [Sacrifice] or pay {Generic}." [1: Silence the Echo]
- **`SpellEffectsComponent(ImmutableList<GameAction> Effects)`** — An instant's or sorcery's text: its target words and its effects, in order.
  - `Modes` (ImmutableList<Mode>): "Choose one/two —": the bullets. Empty for a non-modal spell.
- **`StaticEffectComponent(Filters.Filter Affects, string? Keyword = null)`** — A static ability that changes characteristics while its source is on the battlefield — Saheeli: "Thopters you control have haste" is… [25: Samut, Hazoret's Champion, Ajani's Anguish, Ghalta the Unstoppable…]
  - `If` (Condition?): "As long as [condition]" — threshold, "as long as you control a Jace planeswalker". Never one that reads…
- **`TapsForTwoColorlessWhileExiled(int CardId, int Incarnation)`** — Emrakul's land: "{T}: Add {C}{C}" until that card (this object of it) is cast from exile.
- **`TriggeredAbilityComponent(TriggerEvent On, ImmutableList<GameAction> Effects)`** — "When/Whenever [event], [effects]." Goes on the stack the next time a player would get priority. [1: Hunter's Axe]
  - `Modes` (ImmutableList<Mode>): "When this enters, choose one —": chosen as it goes on the stack (CR 700.2b).
  - `If` (Condition?): "At …, if [condition], …" — intervening: checked as it triggers AND as it resolves (CR 603.4).
  - `FromGraveyard` (bool): Darklight Phoenix: "return this card from your graveyard" — it triggers from there, not the battlefield.
  - `OncePerTurn` (bool): "This ability triggers only once each turn." Stamped on the card as it goes on the stack.
  - `EventSubtype` (string?): Koth: "Whenever a Plains you control enters" — the event's card must have this subtype. Read for triggers…
- **`UntilEndOfTurn(int Power = 0, int Toughness = 0, string? Keyword = null)`** — "Gets +P/+T and gains Keyword until end of turn" on a permanent. Removed in cleanup (CR 514.2) and by any zone change.
  - `UntilTurnOf` (int): "Until your next turn": it lasts until this player's next turn begins (its untap step), not past this…
  - `Trigger` (Effects.TriggeredAbilityComponent?): Lyra: "Until end of turn, whenever [this] deals combat damage to a player, …" — Collect reads it.
  - `ExileIfItWouldDie` (bool): Essence Burn: "if that permanent would die this turn, exile it instead" — MoveCard reads it.
  - `LosesAllAbilities` (bool): Flourishing Grapple: "loses all abilities until end of turn" — Characteristics.HasLostAllAbilities.
- **`YourCreaturesAssignDamageByToughness`** — Ghalta: "Each creature you control with toughness greater than its power assigns combat damage equal to its toughness." [1: Ghalta the Immovable]
- **`YourInstantsAndSorceriesHaveSplitSecond`** — Samut: "Instant and sorcery spells you control have split second." [1: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun]
- **`YourNoncreatureSpellsCostLess(int Amount)`** — Geist of Saint Thalia: "Noncreature spells you cast cost {N} less to cast." On a permanent, read for the card being cast — MtgCore's… [1: Geist of Saint Thalia]
- **`YourPlaneswalkersSurviveZeroLoyalty`** — Sanctum Lurker: "Planeswalkers you control aren't put into their owners' graveyards for having 0 loyalty." [1: Sanctum Lurker]
- **`YourSpellsOfTypeCostLess(Cards.CardType Types, int Amount)`** — Tam, the Possibility: "Planeswalker spells you cast cost {N} less to cast." — Costs.Of. [1: Tam, the Possibility]

## Choices — what a player is asked

- **`ChooseAmongChoice`** — Something Worth Saving: "You may put a [Types] card from among them into your hand."
  - `Zone` (ZoneType): Where the cards are: a graveyard (mill), or exile (Uldaros' copies to cast).
- **`ChooseCardsFromHandChoice`** — Pick N cards from your own hand — mulligan bottoms, discard to hand size.
  - `PlayerId` (int): Whose hand.
  - `DeciderId` (int): Who chooses, if not the hand's owner — Solve for Disappointment: "You choose … from it."
  - `Types` (CardType): Only cards of these types ("a nonland permanent card"); None means any.
- **`ChooseCastChoice`** — How to cast a card in the middle of a resolution: its targets, modes, X — one legal cast each.
- **`ChooseColorChoice`** — "Choose a color." Option id = ManaColor + 1: 0 means "none" across this engine, so no answer may be 0.
- **`ChooseFromLibraryChoice`** — "Search your library for a [Type] card" — any one of them, or none (a search may fail to find).
  - `Supertype` (Supertype): Landcycling: "a basic land card". None means any.
  - `Subtype` (string?): Sphinx's Approach: "a Sphinx creature card".
  - `DifferentNames` (bool): Fblthp: "with different names".
- **`ChooseFromLibraryTopChoice`** — Pick any of the top Count cards of your library — surveil's "put into your graveyard".
- **`ChooseHostChoice`** — An Aura entering without being cast: its controller chooses what it enchants (CR 303.4f).
- **`ChooseKeywordChoice`** — "Your choice of [keywords]" — option ids 1..n, one per keyword.
- **`ChooseModesChoice`** — "Choose one/two —" for a triggered ability as it goes on the stack. Option ids are mode indexes.
- **`ChoosePermanentChoice`** — Pick up to one of your permanents matching a filter — "you may sacrifice a creature". Not targeting: the chooser's battlefield, filtered…
- **`ChooseTargetChoice`** — Choose one target for a triggered ability as it goes on the stack (CR 603.3d).
- **`DeclareAttackerChoice`** — Attack with this creature, and at whom. One per creature that can attack.
- **`DeclareBlockerChoice`** — Block one attacker with this creature, or not. One per creature that can block something.
- **`PayToKeepChoice`** — "Counter it unless its controller pays {N}" — Yes pays. Its own type so the AI's look-ahead can pay.
- **`YesNoChoice`** — "You may …": Yes is picking the one option, No is picking none. Read by IfChosenAction.

## Events — what triggers listen for (`Turns/Triggers.cs`)

- **`AttackedEvent(int CardId)`** — A creature was declared as an attacker — one event per attacker.
- **`AttackersDeclaredEvent(int PlayerId)`** — Attackers were declared — one event however many ("whenever you attack").
- **`BecameTargetEvent(int CardId, int ByPlayerId, int ByStackObjectId)`** — A spell or ability put on the stack with this card as a target (CR 115).
- **`BlocksEvent(int CardId)`** — A creature was declared as a blocker.
- **`CombatDamageToPlayersEvent(ImmutableList<int> PlayerIds)`** — Combat damage was dealt to these players in one damage step ("one or more").
- **`CreatureDealtDamageEvent(int CardId, int Amount)`** — A creature was dealt damage — Hexhaven Invigorator's "that many" is Amount.
- **`DiedEvent(Card LastKnown)`** — A creature or planeswalker went from the battlefield to a graveyard — as it last existed.
- **`DiscardedEvent(int PlayerId, ImmutableList<int> CardIds)`** — A player discarded these cards — one event per discard, however many cards.
- **`EnteredBattlefieldEvent(int CardId, CardType Types = CardType.None)`** — A permanent entered the battlefield — raised by MagicState.EnterBattlefield, the one way in.
- **`LifeGainedEvent(int PlayerId)`** — Raised by Rules.Life.Gain — one per life-gain event, however much (CR 119.9).
- **`LoyaltyActivatedEvent(int PlayerId, int Cost)`** — "Whenever you activate a loyalty ability" — Cost is +N/−N, so "removed two or more" reads it.
- **`LoyaltyCountersPutEvent(int PutterId)`** — A player put loyalty counters on a planeswalker — by a cost, an effect, or its entering with them (CR 122.6).
- **`PlayerDealtDamageEvent(int PlayerId, bool Combat, int SourceId)`** — A player was dealt damage — by Rules.Damage.Deal, combat or not.
- **`SpellCastEvent(int CardId, int PlayerId, int NoncreatureSpellNumber = 0, int Copies = 0)`** — A spell was cast — raised by CastSpellAction.PutOnStack (copies are not cast, and raise none).
- **`StepBeganEvent(Step Step)`** — A step began — "at the beginning of …". Raised for the steps scripted cards trigger on.
- **`SurveilledEvent(int PlayerId)`** — A player surveilled — raised only by Surveil (MagicCore has no Scry yet; "whenever you scry" would need it to raise this too).

## Building blocks — targets, refs, counts

- **`TargetSpec(From From, Filter? Filter = null)`** — What one "target" word allows: a zone, a filter (which objects there), and the targeting rules. Checked when chosen AND again on…
  - `Optional` (bool): "Up to one target" — choosing nothing (id 0) is legal.
  - `NotThePrevious` (bool): The second of "one or two target creatures": optional, and not the first one again.
  - `Or` (TargetSpec?): Fatehold Charm: "target spell or creature" — also legal where this one says, in its own zone. Only the outer…
- **`Ref(RefKind Kind, int Index = 0)`** — Who or what an effect acts on, resolved against the context at resolution: a referent ("you", "target creature", "this"), or All — every…
  - `Zone` (ZoneType?): For All: the zone — Eye of Jace: "cards in your GRAVEYARD"; Ajani: "each creature" (the battlefield).
  - `Filter` (Filter?): For All: which objects there — Ajani: "each creature except for tokens you control". None is every one.
  - `Of` (Ref?): For All: whose zone — Twisted Fates: "each creature target player controls" is Of = Target(i); "your…
- **`Count(int Fixed, Ref? Of = null, CountOf Kind = CountOf.Fixed, int Sign = 1)`** — A number in rules text, counted at resolution. Counting goes through Ref, so "creatures you control" means one thing everywhere. A…
  - `Per` (int): "For every three cards in your graveyard": the count divided by this, rounded down.
  - `Times` (int): Dark Matter Manipulator: "+2/+0 for every seven" — each Per counts this many.

## Vocabulary — enums

- **CountOf**: `Fixed`; `NumberOf` ("the number of [Ref]"); `GreatestPowerOf` ("the greatest power among [Ref]"); `GreatestManaValueOf` (Hapatra: "the greatest mana value among cards in your graveyard"); `DistinctPowersOf` (Loot, the Nexus: "each different power among [Ref]"); `ColorsAmong` (Karn, Gilded Guardian: "each color among [Ref]"); `PowerOf` ("equal to its power"); `LoyaltyOf` ("equal to its loyalty"); `X` (the X paid); `CountersOn` ("+1/+1 counters on [Ref]"); `LifeYouGainedThisTurn`; `CardsYouDrewThisTurn`; `CardsYouDiscardedThisTurn`; `LoyaltyAbilitiesYouActivatedThisTurn`; `BasicLandTypesAmongLandsYouControl` (domain); `CardTypesInAllGraveyards` (Tarmogoyf); `YourSurveilsThisTurn`; `SpellsYouCastThisTurn`; `NoncombatDamageToOpponentsLastTurn`; `NoncombatDamageToOpponentsThisTurn`; `CreaturesDiedThisTurn` (anyone's); `ChargeCountersOn` (Gardenize: "for each charge counter on [Ref]"); `CardsFromLibraryToGraveyardThisTurn` (Cruel Calculations: of the player [Ref]); `NonlandCardsChosen` (Seasoned Cryomancer: "nonland cards [discarded] this way" — the last hand choice); `TotalLoyaltyOf` (Jace, Reality Sculptor: "loyalty counters among Jaces you control"); `SubtypesAmong` (Tam: "planeswalker types among planeswalkers you control")

- **RefKind**: `You`; `EachOpponent`; `EachPlayer`; `Target`; `ControllerOfTarget`; `OwnerOfTarget` (Clash of Elements: "its owner" — wherever the card now is); `Source`; `SourceHost` (an Aura's "enchanted creature" — what the source is attached to); `EventCard`; `EventObject` (ward: "counter it" — the spell or ability that targeted, if it is still that object); `ControllerOfEventCard` (Tetsuko, Pursuer: "that creature's controller"); `All` ("creatures you control", "cards in your graveyard": a zone's objects that match a filter)

- **TriggerEvent**: `SelfEnters`; `AnotherCreatureYouControlEnters`; `SelfAttacks`; `YouCastNoncreatureSpell`; `LandYouControlEnters` (landfall); `YouGainLife`; `SelfDies` (read from the dying card as it last existed (CR 603.10a)); `AnotherCreatureOrPlaneswalkerYouControlDies`; `CreatureYouControlDies`; `OpponentDealtNoncombatDamage`; `SelfDealsCombatDamageToPlayer`; `YourUpkeep`; `EachUpkeep` ("each player's upkeep"); `OpponentsDrawStep`; `YourEndStep`; `EachEndStep` ("the end step" — every turn's); `OpponentsCreatureWithPowerOrToughness1OrLessBlocks` (Tetsuko, Pursuer); `YouActivateLoyaltyAbility`; `YouActivateLoyaltyAbilityRemovingTwoOrMore`; `BeginningOfCombatOnYourTurn`; `YouPutLoyaltyCounters` (Inspired Tethermage: "whenever you put one or more loyalty counters on a planeswalker"); `Reflexive` ("When you do, …" — put on the stack by WhenYouDo, never matched against an event); `AnotherCreatureOrPlaneswalkerYouControlEnters` (Liliana the Repentant); `YouSurveil` ("whenever you scry or surveil" — FRA has no scry); `CreatureYouControlEnters` (Mabel: "Mabel or another creature you control"); `AttachedCreatureAttacks` ("equipped creature attacks", and "Whenever this creature attacks" granted by Equipment); `AttachedCreatureDies` ("When enchanted creature dies" — looks back: the Aura is already gone (CR 603.10a)); `SelfBecomesTargetOfOpponentsSpellOrAbility` (Ruric Thar, Biomagus); `AnotherNontokenCreatureYouControlEnters` (Arni, Humble Scribe); `YouCastArtifactOrCreatureSpell` (Traxos, Scourge Eternal); `APlayerDiscards` (Tinybones: "whenever a player discards one or more cards"); `SelfDiscarded` (Titanbones: "when you discard this card" — FromGraveyard, where the card now is); `CreatureYouControlAttacksPlayerAlone` (Jiang Yanggu, Yuriko — the only attacker, at a player); `YouCastEquipmentOrSpellTargetingYourCreature` (Danitha, Sword of Hope); `YouCastSpellTargetingOpponentOrTheirCreature` (Danitha, Spear of Agony); `YouCastFirstNoncreatureSpellEachTurn` (Plan for All Outcomes); `YouAttack` (Kiora of Salt and Sand: "whenever you attack" — once per declaration); `OpponentsDealtCombatDamageDuringYourTurn` (Fblthp, Impossibly Lost — "one or more", once a step); `CreatureYouControlAttacks` (Ingris Stingerquill — the event card is the attacker); `YouCastPreparedSpell` (Codie — the copy of a prepare spell, cast from exile); `OpponentCastsSpellWithManaValue2OrLess` (Solarium Sentry); `CreatureOpponentControlsEnters` (Gideon the Oathless); `OpponentActivatesLoyaltyAbility` (Gideon the Oathless); `YouCastCreatureSpell` (Flickering Hound); `SelfDealtDamage` (Hexhaven Invigorator — X is how much); `YourFirstMainPhase` (Gardenize: "at the beginning of your first main phase"); `YouCastSpell` (Chandra's emblems: "whenever you cast a spell"); `CreatureAttacksYouOrYourPlaneswalker` (Jace, Reality Sculptor's −3 — the event card is the attacker); `CreatureWithPower4OrMoreYouControlEnters` (Garruk, Curse Breaker — its power as it enters); `CreaturesAttackYourOpponent` (Garruk, Curse Breaker's −4: "one or more creatures attack one of your opponents"); `SelfCast` (Emrakul: "When you cast this spell" — read from the spell on the stack)

- **From**: `Players`; `Battlefield`; `Stack` (spells: an ability on the stack is not a card); `YourGraveyard`; `AnyGraveyard` (Afterthought Sentry: "target card from a graveyard")

- **ManaRestriction**: `None`; `NotForSpellsFromHand` (Heartwood Crafter); `OnlyPlaneswalkerSpells` (Gideon's Memorial); `OnlyNoncreatureSpells` (Chandra, Chill of Compliance)

- **Property**: `Player`; `Source` ("this", so !Is.Source is "another"); `EventCard` ("that creature"; !Is.EventCard is Roiling Canopy's "other"); `AttachedToSource` ("equipped/enchanted creature"); `Token`; `Copy`; `Prepared` (the creature is prepared (it has a copy of its spell in exile)); `PreparedCopy` (Codie: the copy of a prepare spell, cast from exile); `PlusOneCounter` ("with a +1/+1 counter on it"); `EnteredThisTurn`; `AttackedThisTurn`; `Attacking`; `AttackingAPlayer` (Garruk, Curse Breaker: not a planeswalker); `AttackingYou` (Jace, Reality Sculptor: "attacks you or a planeswalker you control"); `Blocking`; `DealtCombatDamage` (Ruric Thar: "as long as they haven't dealt combat damage yet")

- **ReplaceableEvent**: `NoncombatDamageToOpponent` (Tomik: "a source you control … to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls"); `PlusOneCountersOnYourCreature` (Yoshimaru: "+1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control")

- **Stat**: `Power`; `Toughness`; `ManaValue` (on the stack X counts (CR 202.3e))

- **Whose**: `Any`; `You`; `Opponent`

- **ZoneType**: `Hand`; `Library`; `Graveyard`; `Battlefield`; `Exile`; `Stack`; `Command` (emblems, and "until your next turn" effects that outlive their source (CR 408))

## FraCards script helpers (`MagicCore/Sets/Fra/FraCards.cs`)

- `Cadet` — "A 2/2 colorless Wizard Soldier creature token named Cadet." [10: Heartstring Puller, Way of the Healer, Craftwork Crusher…]
- `Beast` — "A 4/4 green Beast creature token with trample." [3: Way of the Wildspeaker, Way of the Deathbringer, Bestial Incursion]
- `Illusion` — "A 1/1 blue Illusion creature token." [1: The Theorist, Jace Beleren]
- `ForestTentacle` — Verdant Kraken: "a 3/3 green Forest Tentacle land creature token" — Forest gives it {T}: Add {G}. [1: Verdant Kraken]
- `Mowu` — "Mowu, a legendary 3/3 green Dog creature token." [1: Jiang Yanggu, Never Alone]
- `Angel` — Lyra: "a 3/3 blue Angel creature token with flying". [3: Lyra, Tolarian Archangel, Blossom-Blessed Angel // Seed Suture, Lyra, Archangel of Dawn]
- `Thopter` — Saheeli: "a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying". [3: Saheeli, Consul of Oversight, Pia, Determined Rebuilder, Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar]
- `Dragon` — Kiora of Fire and Ashes: "a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying". [2: Kiora of Fire and Ashes, Draconic Visitor]
- `Leviathan` — Kiora of Salt and Sand: "an 8/8 blue Leviathan creature token with hexproof". [1: Kiora of Salt and Sand]
- `Treasure` — "A Treasure token. (It's an artifact with '{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.')" [1: Vraska, the Cutting Glare]
- `SculptureTreasure` — Vraska, Soul of Stone: "a 1/1 colorless Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token". [1: Vraska, Soul of Stone]
- `Lotus` — Kwia Vigorbloom: "a colorless artifact token named Lotus". [1: Kwia Vigorbloom]
- `SacrificeForMana` — "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add [N] mana of any (one) color." — Treasure's and Lotus's. [3: Vraska, Soul of Stone, Vraska, the Cutting Glare, Kwia Vigorbloom]
- `AjanisPridemate` — Ajani Resolute: "a 2/2 white Cat Soldier creature token named Ajani's Pridemate". [1: Ajani Resolute]
- `CreateBeast` — "Create a 4/4 green Beast creature token with trample." [2: Garruk, Veiled Butcher, Garruk, Curse Breaker]
- `Heartwood` — Soul Tether: "a Heartwood token (a red and green artifact with '{T}: Add {R} or {G}.')". [1: Heartwood Crafter // Soul Tether]
- `Loyalty` — "[cost]: effects" — a loyalty ability, own or granted. [8: The Theorist, Jace Beleren, Ajani Unrelenting, Ajani Resolute…]
- `Grant` — "Planeswalkers you control have '[cost]: effects'." [9: Way of the Healer, Sanctum Lurker, Way of the Pyromancer…]
- `Target` — "Target [filter]" — a permanent: Target(Is.Creature & Is.Yours) is "target creature you control". [49: Terminal Criticism, Yoshimaru, Scrappy Stray, Way of the Warlord…]
- `Prowess` — "Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)" A scripted trigger, not an engine keyword:… [9: Traxos, Academy Guardian, Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer, Ruric Thar, Biomagus…]
- `PreparesAtYourUpkeep` — "At the beginning of your upkeep, if this creature isn't prepared, it becomes prepared." [3: Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables, Stingerquill Voxmancer // Vicious Verse, Woodwork Prodigy // Soul Tether]
- `Threshold` — Threshold — "as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard". [5: Void Extrapolator // Omit Variables, Theorix Metamage // Omit Variables, Proft, Sinister Mastermind…]
- `YouControlAPlaneswalker` — Dual lands: "enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker" — judged as this land enters. [10: Dedicated Commons, Fatehold Annex, Formidable Commons…]
- `YouControlTwoOrMoreOtherLands` — "Enters tapped unless you control two or more other lands". [5: Deserted Beach, Haunted Ridge, Overgrown Farmland…]
- `YouControlAJace` — "As long as you control a Jace planeswalker". [1: Mind Meanderer]
- `SeedSuture` — Seed Suture: "Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. You gain 1 life." [3: Blossom-Blessed Angel // Seed Suture, Emergency Phytomedic // Seed Suture, Vigorbloom Vanguard // Seed Suture]
- `PeerReview` — Peer Review: "Create a ... Cadet. Surveil 1." [3: Semester Foreseer // Peer Review, Fatehold Chronologist // Peer Review, Prudent Fateseer // Peer Review]
- `ViciousVerse` — Vicious Verse: "deals 1 damage to target opponent." [3: Stingerquill Voxmancer // Vicious Verse, Whiplash Wordsmith // Vicious Verse, Hallway Heckler // Vicious Verse]
- `OmitVariables` — Omit Variables: "Mill three cards." [3: Void Extrapolator // Omit Variables, Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables, Theorix Metamage // Omit Variables]
- `CreateHeartwood` — "Create a Heartwood token. (It's a red and green artifact with '{T}: Add {R} or {G}.')" [3: Aerid Konstrari, Hungering Puppetbeast, Tenured Tethermage]
- `ArtifactsYouControl` — "The number of artifacts you control". [3: Pia, Determined Rebuilder, Aerid Konstrari, Craterclaw Colossus]
- `AnyColorMana` — "{T}: Add one mana of any color." — five abilities, one per colour, sharing a restriction. [1: Gideon's Memorial]
- `SoulTether` — Soul Tether: "Create a Heartwood token." [3: Konstrari Improviser // Soul Tether, Woodwork Prodigy // Soul Tether, Heartwood Crafter // Soul Tether]
- `BasicLandcycling` — "Basic landcycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.)" [5: Hexhaven Battalion, Undulating Witness, Apex Witchstalker…]
- `ReturnsWithFinality` — "[Cost]: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it." [2: Grim Repriser, Proctor of Potential]
- `Ward` — "Ward {N} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {N}.)"… [3: Unflinching Hortimancer, Wrecking Gecko, Kwia Vigorbloom]
- `Equip` — "Equip {N} ({N}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)" [4: Medic's Kitesail, Hunter's Axe, Warrior's Blades…]
- `AttachedGets` — "Equipped/enchanted creature gets +P/+T." [5: Medic's Kitesail, Ferocity of the Hunt, Hunter's Axe…]
- `TeyoEnters` — The Teyos: "When Teyo enters, target permanent you control gains [keyword] until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it if it's a… [2: Teyo, Lightshield Expert, Teyo, Diamondblade Mage]
- `M` — One bullet: its target words and effects. Its text is filled in from the card. [18: Surgical Precision, Divining Duelist, Perfected Theory…]
- `ModalSpell` — "Choose one/two —" spell. The modes must match the printed bullets one for one. [13: Surgical Precision, Perfected Theory, Rise of the Deathbringer…]
- `Printed` — Names each mode with its printed bullet — and refuses a script whose count differs.
